The main takeaway from our work is that
urine is an excellent source of DNA for genomic analyses, and that exome capture is the most successful approach for sequencing low‐quality DNA.

, for species that can be non‐invasively sampled, urine may be a better source of DNA than faecal samples, and exome sequencing is a better method than either shotgun or whole‐genome capture for generating usable genomic data from low‐DNA‐yield samples.
, for species where noninvasive samples are available, urine is a promising source of DNA that should be explored for future population genomic studies.
